{{Infobox |eng = Duck Egg |source = [[Duck]]s |sellprice = 95 |edibility = 15 }} The '''Duck Egg''' is an [[:Category:Animal Products|animal product]] obtained from a [[Duck]]. Duck Eggs may also be available at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|95}}. One Duck Egg can sometimes be purchased for {{Price|2500}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. Duck Eggs can be hatched in an [[incubator]], which comes with a Big or Deluxe [[Coop]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Robin,Maru,Caroline,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Elliott,Gus,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo |like=Demetrius,Linus,Pierre,Alex,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Harvey |hate=Sebastian |dislike=Abigail,Pam,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Dwarf,Wizard }} ==Bundles== *Duck Egg is an option for the {{Bundle|Animal||y}}. *Ten Eggs (any type, excluding Dinosaur) are required for the {{Bundle|homecook||y}}. ==Artisan Goods== :''See also: [[Animal Products Profitability]]'' {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredient !Equipment !Time !Sell Price |- |[[File:Duck Mayonnaise.png]] |[[Duck Mayonnaise]] |{{Description|Duck Mayonnaise}} |{{Name|Duck Egg|1}} |style="text-align: center;"|[[File: Mayonnaise Machine.png]]
[[Mayonnaise Machine]] |{{duration|3 Hours}} |{{Price|375}} |} ==Recipes== When used for [[Cooking]], Duck Eggs are interchangeable with other [[Egg]]s.{{#lsth:Egg|Recipes}} ==Tailoring== Duck Egg can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt270.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Green Jacket Shirt]]. It can be used as a white [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== *[[Quests#Gus' Famous Omelet|"Gus' Famous Omelet"]]: On the Special Orders board in front of the [[Mayor's Manor]], [[Gus]] may randomly request that the player collect and deliver 24 Eggs (of any type) to the fridge in [[the Stardrop Saloon]].
